summary: Return the editorial feeds shown on the Jamendo homepage.
description: Returns the editorial feeds that appear on the Jamendo homepage. Only active feeds (those whose start and end dates include the current date) are returned. Each feed contains URLs for the image sizes 996_350, 315_111, 600_211, and 470_165. The default ordering is position_asc. The endpoint requires a client_id API key and supports pagination, filtering, and sorting parameters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps the JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with format=json or jsonpretty and GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 10, max 200). The keyword 'all' is capped at 200.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by one or more fields. Append _asc or _desc to indicate direction; default is ascending.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the response header includes results_fullcount (total rows without limit/offset). Use sparingly as it impacts performance.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Filter feeds to those that have text in the specified language. Other languages may still appear inside the feed.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Select feeds targeted to logged users, notlogged users, or all. Feeds can belong to multiple categories.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter feeds by one or more feed types.

responseFields.name: headers.error_message
responseFields.description: Error message if the request failed.

responseFields.name: headers.warnings
responseFields.description: Any warnings returned by the API.

responseFields.name: headers.results_count
responseFields.description: Number of feed objects returned in this response.

responseFields.name: results[].title
responseFields.description: Localized titles keyed by language code.

responseFields.name: results[].lang
responseFields.description: Language code of the primary feed text.

responseFields.name: results[].target
responseFields.description: Target audience for the feed (all, logged, notlogged).

responseFields.name: results[].type
responseFields.description: Feed type (album, artist, playlist, track, news, interview, contest, video, update).

responseFields.name: results[].joinid
responseFields.description: ID of the related album/artist/track/playlist when type is one of those.

responseFields.name: results[].urls
responseFields.description: Map of image size keys (e.g., 996_350) to URL strings.

notes: client_id is mandatory for every request (API key authentication).
limit cannot exceed 200; the special value 'all' is still capped at 200.
order defaults to position_asc if not provided.
fullcount should only be used when the total result count is needed because it adds overhead.
callback works only with format=json or jsonpretty and a GET request; otherwise it is ignored with a warning.
